verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a public API reference and an official MCP server, which a probe confirmed at docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/. It also publishes an llms.txt index, and its logs and APM/tracing products are documented, so an external agent has supported paths to query telemetry for production debugging. The pack only gives page titles, so it does not show which metrics, logs, and traces operations the API or MCP server actually expose. Missing for 10: detail on the API/MCP query coverage for metrics, logs, and traces; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths (all returned 404); independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent debugging via these interfaces.
